an4.76:5.6: bhante → bhante imasmiṁ bhikkhusaṅghe (bj); bhante imasmiṁ bhikkhusaṁghe (sya-all) | bhikkhusaṅghe → bhikkhasaṁghe (sya-all)
an4.76:6.1: ñāṇameva hettha → ñāṇamevettha (sya-all) | vā imesañhi → vāti imesaṁ hi (sya-all) | ñāṇameva → ñātameva (bj: katthaci)
an4.76:6.2: imesañhi → imesaṁ hi (bj) | sambodhiparāyaṇoti chaṭṭhaṁ → sambodhiparāyanoti (sya-all)
